sentences.text:
The notification has been challenged on the ground that the same has been issued stating that land in question is to be acquired for public purpose i.e. extension of parking in front of Triveni Sangrahalaya for respondent No.3 without conducting any social impact assessment as required under Section 4 of the Act, 2013 looking into the urgency contemplated under Section 40 of the Act,
2013.
It is submitted that extension of parking is not public purpose as defined under Section 2(1) of the Act, 2013 which cannot be said to be an urgency contemplated under Section 40 of the Act.

It is further submitted that the petitioner has submitted an objection before respondent No.1 under Section 15 of the Act, 2013 on 08.01.2013 but the same has not been decided within the period contemplated under Section 15 of the Act, 2013 which is mandatory before proceeding further in the matter.
3. I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and have perused the record.

(2) Every objection under sub-section (1) shall be made to the Collector in writing,
and the Collector shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard in person or by any person authorised by him in this behalf or by an Advocate and shall, after hearing all such objections and after making such further inquiry, if any, as he thinks necessary, either make a report in respect of the land which has been notified under sub-section (1) of section 11, or make different reports in respect of different parcels of such land, to the appropriate Government, containing his recommendations on the objections, together with the record of the proceedings held by him along with a separate report giving therein the approximate cost of land acquisition, particulars as to the number of affected families likely to be resettled, for the decision of that Government.
(3) The decision of the appropriate Government on the objections made under sub-section (2) shall be final.
5. As per the aforesaid provision every objection made thereunder to the Collector in writing has to be decided by affording opportunity of hearing to the objector.
However as per the petitioner, his objection has not been decided and respondents 1 and 2 are proceeding further in the matter.
